💰 **Salary, based on experience level:

**🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross

🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

**Intro

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_****Why Monta

**

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.description:
_Recently graduated or one to two years into your career? Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now.

__Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

**About The Job

**At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and help shape how we work.

**What You Will Do

**As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for your own tasks. At the same time, you will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Helping identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data points with stakeholders and assessing which are critical for Saxo

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and contribute to root cause investigations

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Collaborating with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

**Who You Are

**You have recently graduated or have around one to two years of professional experience.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• A relevant degree in finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, data science or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it is used in business processes

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or projects

• Hands on experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

**It would be an advantage if you have

**

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

• Familiarity with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar tools

Just as important as your experience is how you approach your work.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who

**

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You adapt as priorities develop, bring structure to areas that are still taking shape and contribute to building solutions together with the team.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn.

**What We Offer

**

• The opportunity to help build a new data function from the ground up

• A steep learning curve across Markets, critical data and data governance, supported by experienced colleagues

• Hands on guidance, regular feedback and an introduction to both your Markets domain and our governance practices

• Real responsibility from the beginning, with the opportunity to take on more as you develop

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, so your role will develop alongside the team. You can expect new challenges, increasing responsibility and the opportunity to influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

**Job description

**We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

**What you’ll do

**In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• 
**Design and implement planning excellence

**: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• 
**Enable adoption and capability building

**: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• 
**Translate requirements into actionable processes

**: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• 
**Guide digital planning transformations

**: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• 
**Deliver measurable impact

**: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note this role is based in our **Copenhagen

**office.

**What you’ll bring

**As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• 
**Relevant experience

**: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• 
**Project-driven and adaptable

**: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• 
**Interest in digital tools

**: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• 
**Analytical problem-solver

**: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

**At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• 
**Build deep functional expertise

**: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• 
**Hands-on from day one

**: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• 
**Continuous development

**: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• 
**High-trust culture

**: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• 
**International environment

**: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

Make your next move matter.

**How to apply

**Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027.

**About Implement

**Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

We are looking for a Product Compliance Manager to join Veo's newly established Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team.

As Veo continues to grow, we navigate a broad range of regulatory requirements across our products and business, from certifications, product safety, and environmental regulation to market access and broader compliance obligations.

In this role, you will focus on product-related regulatory compliance and certifications, while also working across Veo's broader compliance agenda. You will work closely with colleagues across Hardware, Product Development, Production, Procurement and other parts of the business to understand applicable requirements and help translate them into practical processes and solutions.

You will join a small GRC team with a broad mandate and significant exposure across Veo. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding regulation, technology, and business.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Coordinate Veo's product certification and market-access activities across relevant markets, working closely with Hardware, Production and other internal stakeholders.

• Monitor and assess new and changing regulatory requirements relevant to Veo and help determine their practical implications for our products and business.

• Develop and maintain a structured overview of regulatory and certification requirements applicable to Veo's products throughout their lifecycle.

• Drive and coordinate implementation of regulatory and compliance requirements across relevant business functions, ensuring clear ownership, appropriate documentation and timely follow-up.

• Work with regulatory frameworks relevant to Veo's products, including areas such as product safety, batteries, electrical and electronic equipment, environmental requirements, waste and recycling obligations and related product compliance requirements.

• Coordinate with external certification bodies, laboratories, consultants and other specialists where required.

• Maintain and develop compliance documentation, certification records, technical files, declarations and other evidence required to demonstrate compliance.

• Support the assessment of regulatory and compliance implications when Veo enters new markets, introduces new products or makes material changes to existing products.

• Support Veo's broader compliance activities, including policies, procedures, monitoring, due diligence, risk assessments and training.

• Support customer, auditor and other stakeholder requests relating to compliance and certifications.

• Contribute to the continued development of Veo's broader GRC framework and take part in cross-functional compliance projects as required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• Relevant higher education in engineering, technology, law, business, quality/compliance, or another relevant discipline.

• Relevant professional experience within product compliance, regulatory compliance, certification, quality/regulatory affairs or a similar area, preferably from an international company.

• Experience working with regulatory requirements affecting hardware or electronic products is an advantage.

• Experience with one or more areas such as product safety, product certifications, battery regulation, electrical/electronic equipment regulation, environmental product requirements, waste/recycling regulation or similar regulatory regimes.

• Experience coordinating certification processes, testing, technical documentation, declarations or interactions with certification bodies and laboratories is highly relevant.

• Broader compliance experience, for example within sanctions and export controls, third-party due diligence, anti-bribery and corruption or other corporate compliance areas, is an advantage.

• An ability to understand complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical requirements for technical, operational and commercial teams.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating initiatives across different functions and areas of expertise.

• A structured approach to documentation, monitoring and follow-up, combined with the ability to identify and prioritize material compliance risks.

• Strong business understanding and a pragmatic approach to compliance. You should be comfortable finding solutions that meet regulatory requirements while enabling the business to operate effectively.

**Our Purpose

**Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

**Experience & Skills

**

• 4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

jobs.description:
**Strategic Procurement Specialist – Indirect Goods & Services

**Do you find motivation in building value through teamwork, strategic sourcing, and productive supplier partnerships? Would you like to help shape procurement decisions across Nordic retail organizations and contribute to a more efficient and sustainable business? Then keep reading.

As our new Procurement Specialist, Indirect Goods & Services (IGS), you will play an important role in developing category plans, managing sourcing projects, and partnering with colleagues across the Nordic markets to identify opportunities and deliver value.

As a member of our Indirect Goods & Services (IGS) team, you will report to the Head of Procurement, Nonfood and contribute to advancing the IGS agenda throughout the Nordics.

**What You'll Be Doing

**In this role, you will:

• Develop and execute category plans and sourcing strategies across assigned indirect goods and services categories

• Deliver cost savings, working capital improvements, and other value-creation initiatives

• Manage end-to-end sourcing projects, including analysis, tender management, supplier selection, negotiation, and implementation

• Negotiate and manage commercial agreements while ensuring compliance with procurement governance and policies

• Build and maintain positive supplier relationships, promoting performance, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Provide strategic procurement support and advisory to internal stakeholders across the Nordic organizations

• Utilize market insights, benchmarking, and data analysis to support decision-making and identify new opportunities

• Support process enhancements and contribute to the continued evolution of procurement tools and best practices

**What We're Looking For

**We know that great candidates do not always meet every requirement, but we imagine that you bring:

• 1-5 years of experience within procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or a related commercial discipline

• Experience managing supplier relationships and commercial negotiations

• Solid analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical recommendations

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a changing business environment

• Knowledge of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies, and contract management

• Experience working with data, Excel, and procurement-related systems

• Interest in IT/AI is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Professional proficiency in English and at least one Nordic language

**Who You Are

**You enjoy working with people and building relationships across different functions and cultures. You combine strategic thinking with a practical approach and are at ease working through both complexity and change.

**You Are Likely Someone Who

**

• Communicates clearly and builds trust with colleagues and partners

• Takes initiative and follows through on commitments

• Collaborates effectively across teams and markets

• Is curious, methodical, and open to new perspectives

• Stays organized while managing multiple priorities

• Approaches challenges with a positive and solution-oriented mindset

• Works well both on your own and as part of a team

• Seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

**What We Offer

**At Coop Trading, you'll be part of an international and collaborative environment where you can help shape decisions and contribute to meaningful business results.

**We Offer

**

• An exciting role with broad exposure across the Nordic markets

• The opportunity to shape sourcing strategies and procurement initiatives

• Collaboration with experienced colleagues and stakeholders across four countries

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• A culture built on trust, teamwork, learning, and continuous improvement

• Flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance

Workplace: Our office is located at Skelbækgade 2, 1717 Copenhagen V.

We believe that a positive culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while we offer the flexibility to work from home when needed.

The role includes approximately 20-35 travel days per year, including occasional overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact **Head of Procurement, Nonfood Michael Bjunes at +45 2777 2432.

**If you are ready to join Coop Trading's Procurement team, please send us your application and CV no later than 27th of November 2026. We review applications on an on-going basis.

**About Us

**Coop Trading’s purpose is to make a better every day through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers delivering the best quality products at a fair price. Our portfolio encompasses both food and daily non-food items within our private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

Coop Trading represents Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, as well as SOK in Finland. Through our private brands, we are proud to be present on every third dinner table in Nordic homes. On behalf of our four partners, we develop products for our private brand portfolio through innovation, product development, and negotiating Nordic agreements.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

Are you ready to combine creative craft, 3D design and AI-powered tools to create impactful content at scale?

**As our new AI-Powered Content Designer, you will create and evolve visual content for global campaigns, products and regional markets—balancing brand consistency with local relevance.

In the role of 3D & AI Content Designer in the Global Brand, Content & Digital team, you will create, adapt and scale high-quality visual content, including product CGI and contextual imagery, using AI-powered and 3D design tools.

**The Team You Will Be Part Of

**You will join the Design team within Global Brand, Content & Digital, a creative function responsible for content across launches and campaigns. Reporting to the Senior Design Lead, you will work closely with Brand, Content, Paid Media and regional marketing teams to bring campaign ideas to life across global markets.

We are a collaborative team that combines creative curiosity with structured execution. We use new technologies, including AI, to increase the scale and relevance of our content while maintaining high visual and brand standards.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

**

• Create product CGI, 3D renders and contextual imagery for campaigns, launches and digital channels

• Use AI-powered design tools to create, adapt and iterate visual content for global, regional and local needs

• Translate regional briefs into relevant, high-quality visual assets tailored to audiences, product categories and use cases

• Develop reusable templates, design frameworks and workflows that support efficient content scaling

• Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, visual standards, technical specifications and production requirements

• Partner with regional marketing, Brand, Content and Paid Media teams to understand priorities, market context and audience insights

• Explore new AI and 3D capabilities, contributing ideas that improve creative workflows, content quality and production efficiency

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring experience creating product CGI and 3D renders, using Cinema 4D or similar 3D design software

• May have experience with AI-powered design tools, such as Canva, Leonardo or equivalent platforms, and are ready to explore new technologies

• Bring a graphic design portfolio that demonstrates visual judgement across content types, including composition, typography and colour

• Can interpret creative briefs, communicate design choices clearly and work well with regional and cross-functional stakeholders

• Are curious, structured and self-managing, with the ability to manage several projects, ask thoughtful questions and incorporate feedback

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 15. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

_Are you passionate about defining and realizing complex technical systems? Do you thrive at the intersection of architecture, development, integration, and validation? Do you want to play a key role in shaping the technical foundation of Kamstrup’s next generation of smart metering solutions?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Lead Systems Engineer, your job will be to drive the technical definition and realization of complex smart metering solutions across hardware, firmware, connectivity, and cloud domains, ensuring robust and verifiable solutions throughout the product lifecycle.

You will act as a key technical authority between architecture and implementation, governing the system's perspective across disciplines and ensuring that system requirements, interfaces, integration, and validation are aligned from concept to deployment.

More specifically you will be:

• Defining and maintaining system requirements, system behavior, and technical specifications.

• Leading technical alignment across hardware, firmware, software, connectivity, and cloud domains.

• Driving system integration and supporting cross disciplinary troubleshooting.

• Ensuring traceability between requirements, design, verification, and validation activities.

• Playing a central role in technical reviews, risk assessments, and critical engineering decisions.

You will experience the opportunity to join a growing Systems Engineering capability and help shape how future smart metering solutions are developed at Kamstrup. Therefore, you will work with advanced connectivity and Internet of Things technologies while collaborating closely with Solution Architects, developers, and product teams. This is a highly visible technical role with significant influence on product direction, engineering excellence, and the future development of the Systems Engineering discipline.

**Meet your future team

**With direct references to the Director of Connectivity, you will become part of the Solutions Architects team within the Water Division. Together with colleagues in Connectivity Development and Connectivity Technology, the team is responsible for defining the solution foundations that enable smart metering products across the Kamstrup portfolio. In the team you will experience an informal and collaborative environment characterized by technical excellence, strong knowledge sharing, and a shared ambition to continuously improve the way we develop products and solutions.

Did you know? Our teams bring together specialists within architecture, connectivity, embedded systems, and product development, creating a unique environment where complex technical challenges are solved through close collaboration across disciplines.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an experienced Systems Engineer with a proven track record of delivering complex technical solutions in multidisciplinary environments. You achieve work-related goals by combining strong systems thinking with the ability to influence technical direction, drive alignment across engineering domains, and take ownership of technical outcomes.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• Bring extensive experience developing and delivering complex embedded or hardware-based products.

• Possess strong knowledge of systems engineering, requirements engineering, system integration, verification, and validation.

• Demonstrate the ability to drive technical decisions across hardware, firmware, software, connectivity, and cloud domains.

• Have a proven track record of leading technical alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders.

As an added advantage, you may also have experience with requirements management tools, system specification, verification and validation, and wireless communication technologies; familiarity with IoT connectivity solutions across short-range, long-range, and cellular networks; knowledge of standardized interoperability protocols and industry frameworks and the ability to apply a structured and analytical approach to solving complex technical challenges.

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish proficiency is considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours.

• Employee benefits include a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community.

• Beneficial health care and insurance package.

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director, Connectivity, Kristen Kasper Hansen, by phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible all with the purpose of securing clean water and energy to the maximum number of people. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us. Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

NG Nordic is a leading provider of circular solutions and environmental services in the Nordics. By transforming waste into valuable resources and removing hazardous substances from the material cycle, we reduce emissions, protect natural ecosystems, and increase access to circular materials. NG Nordic is an important part of the Nordic industrial infrastructure, generating revenue of EUR 1.3 billion with a team of around 3,400 employees and 90 facilities.

Health & Safety Specialist, Nyborg, Denmark

Do you want to be the Safety Shoulder and make a real difference to safety in one of Europe’s most complex industrial environments?

Be the trusted Health & Safety voice in daily operations at NG Nordic’s hazardous waste treatment facility in Nyborg.

As Health & Safety Specialist, you will work close to the operational teams, helping managers and employees turn safety requirements into practical actions. You will be part of a five-person team in Nyborg and work as an integrated partner to Operations.

Nyborg is a Seveso III facility and is described as the EU’s largest hazardous waste treatment plant. Here, health and safety is not simply a compliance exercise: the risks are real, and your work can have a direct impact on people, processes and operational reliability.

Your role combines visible presence in the plant with reporting, statistics, procedures, training and improvement projects. You will advise and challenge Operations constructively, build trust across functions and help ensure a safe, professional operation.

The position is based in Nyborg and requires regular engagement with employees, supervisors and managers throughout the facility.

You will turn safety requirements into practical improvements in daily operations

You will participate in daily and weekly operational meetings, identify and prioritise EHSQ risks, and help the organisation address the issues that matter most. You will balance proactive safety work with administrative responsibilities and timely follow-up.

Your key tasks will include:

• Acting as the Health & Safety partner to Operations, advising managers and employees and participating in daily and weekly operational meetings

• Conducting safety walks, workplace inspections, toolbox talks and awareness activities, and following up on identified risks

• Preparing safety reports, statistics and KPI follow-up, identifying trends and recommending actions

• Developing and implementing practical safety procedures, training programmes, onboarding and contractor inductions

• Supporting risk assessments, audits, investigations and structured root-cause analyses of incidents and near misses

• Driving and prioritising safety improvement projects, monitoring corrective actions and supporting compliance with Danish legislation, internal standards and Seveso-related requirements

Experience from health and safety in industrial operations

We imagine that you have a relevant technical or health and safety qualification and approximately five years or more of experience in a comparable operational environment. Experience from process industry, chemicals, hazardous waste, energy or other high-risk facilities is especially relevant.

You understand occupational health and safety legislation, operational risk assessments, incident investigation, safety management systems and the importance of effective training and documentation. You are comfortable working with reports, statistics and digital tools.

You can translate complex safety requirements into clear, workable solutions. You communicate confidently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing, and you know how to engage colleagues across functions and organisational levels.

You build credibility through presence, sound judgement and constructive dialogue. You have the natural authority to challenge unsafe practices while maintaining trust and respect, and you are robust enough to handle disagreement and pressure.

You are structured, proactive and able to prioritise competing tasks. You enjoy combining hands-on operational work with analysis, administration and continuous improvement, always keeping the most significant risks in focus.

Interested?

If you want to help create a safer and more professional operation in an environment where safety genuinely matters, we would like to hear from you.

NG Nordic is partnering with Brinch & Partners on this recruitment. For questions about the role, contact Partner Jens Chr. Jensen at +45 7020 2328. Please submit your CV and application in English.

We interview candidates on an ongoing basis.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

We want our recruitment process to be fair and inclusive. That is why we do not ask for photos or lengthy cover letters. Instead, we use screening questions to ensure comparable applications. We do, however, ask for gender information to help us ensure good gender balance in the recruitment process.
